channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jarrett Jack | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jarrett Jack from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
Bickerstaff on Jarrett Jack:

“He's always been a leader, a guy that who wanted to lead guys and people will follow... I'm going to be leaning on him a ton because he's been working with these guys in the past.”

JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Jack, Jul 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
“He would just need a few years. And for me, having Jarrett Jack telling me he's good, that means a lot.”

Draymond Green on Jarrett Jack, Mar 18, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
Both coaches, like Durant, grew up in P.G. County, a region of Maryland right outside Washington D.C. Jack’s family ran AAU programs in the area, tournaments that Durant played in year-round for much of his childhood.

“Seeing Jarrett and his brother Justin running around the gym, I’ve just been knowing them since I was a baby,”

Kevin Durant on Jarrett Jack, Mar 13, 2023. Source: Arizona's Sports Page.

item.title: Devin Booker on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
Devin Booker, Phoenix's star guard, says.

“But it was almost better hearing it from someone [Jack] who wasn't in our program last year. He confirmedit.”

Devin Booker on Jarrett Jack, Dec 21, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jonathan Kuminga on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Kuminga on playing with Jarrett Jack:

“Just being around Jarrett Jack means a lot. He used to push me every day.”

Jonathan Kuminga on Jarrett Jack, Jul 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
“Same with Jarrett (Jack). We have three guys for that spot. And we'll look at how it goes. Nobody is great every single night.”

Jeff Hornacek on Jarrett Jack, Jan 20, 2018. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Scott Perry on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
After beating out Ramon Sessions for a spot in the lineup, Jack has started 36 consecutive games and leads the Knicks in assists.

“Jarrett has been a leader for the Knicks on and off the court,”

Scott Perry on Jarrett Jack, Jan 7, 2018. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
Asked which leader he learned the most from, Curry responded,

“Jarrett Jack had a big influence on me here [in Golden State].”

Stephen Curry on Jarrett Jack, Dec 5, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
But Prokhorov had no interest in discussing it, instead taking the opportunity to praise Jarrett Jack – Williams’ replacement as the Nets’ starting point guard.

“I will say in that way that we have a great leader at point guard in Jarrett Jack,”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Jarrett Jack, Sep 30, 2015. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
Irving decided to wear the shirt two days ago.

“I was in contact with Jarrett Jack and I was like ‘I want one of those shirts and I’m going to wear it,’”

Kyrie Irving on Jarrett Jack, Dec 9, 2014. Source: For The Win.

item.title: Mark Jackson on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
Tim Kawakami:From Mark Jackson:

“I think it’s important for us to have somebody we can trust with the basketball behind Steph. Ideally, it’s Jack.”

Mark Jackson on Jarrett Jack, May 20, 2013. Source: Twitter @timkawakami.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Jarrett Jack, Carl Landry
item.description:
Marcus Thompson:Andrew Bogut on Jack and Landry:

“In an ideal world, you'd like to keep both. But the reality is we probably can't keep both.”

Andrew Bogut on Jarrett Jack, Carl Landry, May 17, 2013. Source: Twitter @gswscribe.

item.title: Ty Lawson on Jarrett Jack, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson
item.description:
Marcus Thompson:Ty Lawson on GSW w/o Lee:

“I think Curry and Klay Thompson are going to be a lot more aggressive,and Jack ... gotta try to slow them down.”

Ty Lawson on Jarrett Jack, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Apr 22, 2013. Source: Twitter @gswscribe.

item.title: Bob Myers on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
Marcus Thompson:Myers:

“Our team immediately got better. We think we got a player here. It's hard to find guys who move the needle. We got one in Jack.”

Bob Myers on Jarrett Jack, Jul 12, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jarrett Jack
item.description:
Monty Williams said the Hornets will try to sign a backup point guard who can be ready to play eight hours from now against the Lakers.

“We need to find someone who can do for us what Greivis did off the bench (when Jack was starting),”

Monty Williams on Jarrett Jack, Apr 9, 2012. Source: Hornets.com.
